record_hierarchical_data: record a hierarchical data structure containing torch tensors and metadata for IPU processing
collect_all_tensors: collect all torch tensors from a nested dict or list into a flat list
update_all_tensors: update all tensors in the hierarchical data structure from a flat list of new tensors
update_hierarchical_data: update hierarchical data in-place by replacing tensors while preserving the original structure
clean_all_tensors: remove all torch tensors from the hierarchical data structure by replacing them with None
